title: Missing Physical Controls and Features
summary: This topic centers on owners mentioning features or controls they miss, especially physical buttons, older-style shifters and vents, while a few positive comments note mechanical door levers, good visibility, or desired convenience features.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention mechanical door levers, excellent visibility, interest in audio buffering, and a desire for added convenience features such as dog mode.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention missing older physical controls or features such as buttons, shifters, vents, seat massage, and a sunroof, but the short fragments do not always make the overall sentiment fully clear.

limitations: Many fragments are very short or lack context, so the overall sentiment and exact requested change are often unclear.
The topic mixes several loosely related subjects, including missed physical controls, absent comfort features, and unrelated positive remarks about visibility or audio behavior.
Samples are stratified and not representative, so they should not be used to infer how common these preferences are among all owners.
